sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Amit Ahlawat,
 Insp. Harjinder  with SI Meeta P  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 13.09.2024 1.
Written submission of the parties are on record.
2. Counsel for petitioner states that on the basis of the FIR and the statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the charges cannot be made out.
3. Counsel for respondent, however, states that there is sufficient material on record to make out charges under Sections 498A/406 and 313 IPC.
This Court, at this stage, is not inclined to allow the revision petition of the petitioner.
However, counsel for petitioner seeks some more time to place judgments on record; he is permitted to do so.

4. List on 10th January, 2025.
5.
In the meantime, it is made clear that there is no stay order by this Court, and the trial Court shall proceed irrespective.
6. Order be uploaded on the website of this court.
ANISH DAYAL, J SEPTEMBER 13, 2024/RK
